[h2]Fixes[/h2]
- Fixed some gloves not interacting with the stick shader correctly
- Fixed a geometry gap in the hot dog suit when wearing the Goosan head

[h2]Additions[/h2]
- Added [b]match_id[/b] to the match logs locally, on the website and through the API as requested by developers

- Reworked the elf hat to reflect our new cosmetics standards. The old version is now a variant.

[h2]The Golden Geese[/h2]
We have replaced the Blackhawks cosmetics with The Golden Geese, a hockey team in the Slappyverse. notes.title: Netcode and bandwidth improvements, mods policy change, the road ahead
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37173422/a4947c71fc9b526050b6c4689b67b82f998309cd.png[/img]

[h1]Rebound v1.3.1 is now live ːreboundː[/h1]

[h2]Improvements[/h2]
- Several netcode improvements have been made that will help improve the worst case scenarios
- Reduced the bandwidth usage of the game slightly to improve slow connections

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
- Futuristick now has a stick highlight
- Created a permanent fix for the Steam authentication change
- Fixed players sometimes being literally frozen (with ice) on the end game screen
- Patched a minor security concern that could crash servers ($200 bug bounty awarded to Wallie for reporting it)

[h2]Modding Policy Update[/h2]
Before today, our policy on modding was to allow it as long as there was no competitive advantage and didn't go around our monetisation. Unfortunately we need to take a different stance to maintain the competitive integrity and stability of the game. From this update onwards [b]modding is no longer allowed[/b]. You'll notice if you have mods installed, the game will not work. Make sure to completely uninstall the game and install it again to fix this problem. We are not taking action this update so the news of the policy change can spread but from v1.4.0 onwards we will start taking action against the accounts of people that modify the game. In the past, we have seen mods as more advanced feature requests and have implemented several concepts into the game in an official capacity (clubs system for casters, arena changes, dark ice,..). There are a few cool mods that we still plan to implement officially after this change to make sure legit players don't lose out on any functionality. Thank you for your understanding.

[h2]The Road Ahead[/h2]
We've been asked about what the future brings for Slapshot, here's some more insight into our plans:
- We're currently working on an overhaul to the shop. A lot of people have told us they wait way too long for a rotation as the amount of cosmetics we have increases.
- Season 2 is in production. We're planning to create a smaller season pass with 30 tiers (which will also be cheaper). With a new season come season rewards, these are in production too. We're estimating a release for late October. An official announcement with the exact date will be made at least one month before its release.
- After the above, we plan to focus on a full game replay system as the next major feature. It's still some time out but it will happen!
- Of course smaller additions and improvements will still be made as always

Happy slapping!

notes.title: Slapshot Rebound 1.0 is releasing on April 11th!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37173422/3733f494eb7f9835f12f70a4d7784d4f5a66e4fe.png[/img]

Slappers, we're really excited to bring you the 1.0 version of Slapshot Rebound on April 11th. We've been hard at work on the game every day since the Early Access release in December 2020 when we made a promise to the community on our vision of the game and what we wanted to add to it. April's update will deliver the remainder of those initial promises and starts a new chapter for Slapshot Rebound.

[h2]The Pond[/h2]
With the full release comes [b]The Pond[/b], a social sandbox hub to practice and hang out at while you're waiting for a match or any other time. It contains several minigames, pucks, and other features to give you a no pressure environment to skate around in. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37173422/f70a7b916e097f6a1ec0b6ba17b1605a2177e4fb.png[/img]

[h2]Season 1[/h2]
Full release introduces [b]Season 1[/b], which will conclude Pre-Season 2. It comes with a soft reset of skill ratings, an all-new season pass featuring over 50 cosmetics, ranked season rewards and several changes to how ranks and matchmaking work behind the scenes.

[h3]Season 1 pass sneak peek ːtrainerbuddyː[/h3]
We saw the amazing feedback you've given us about the season pass and the system we've made for it, so we're doing another! When the Season 1 pass launches, you will be able to choose which pass you make progress towards and earn rewards from - even if you never bought any. The pux received from completing the premium track of the current pass will be enough to purchase the Season 1 pass.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37173422/559e3799f284678e6eb1171d49bbe5f15a5f3c9b.png[/img]

[h3]Pre-Season 2 rewards: Gloves![/h3]
This season's rewards will be distributed on April 11th with the launch. You will receive the gloves for the highest rank you have achieved in the season and all ranks below it as well as a unique title. The gloves are made to fit perfectly with the sticks from Pre-Season 1.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37173422/2927a1d6c9f36b914fd2584405ead209a45ce87f.png[/img]

[h2]5 Years of Slapshot[/h2]
The first Slapshot game released on March 8th, 2019. Today marks the 5th anniversary of the game franchise! As a homage to the player characters who were simple poker chips during the Slapshot 1 beta, you can redeem the Poker Chip back cosmetic for free by using code [b]FIVEYEARS[/b] in the in-game shop until March 22nd. Check out [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vQAfGJGT7E8]LaffTrakk's montage[/url] recapping some amazing moments of the last 5 years.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37173422/487ca592e3f1737e41389ac38614a7c47db52282.png[/img]

[h2]What's after?[/h2]
The game's full release does not mean that it is finished, but that it is graduating from the beta state it was in during Early Access. Over the course of the last 3+ years we have added a lot of features, fine-tuned gameplay and polished the game. We will keep doing exactly that and build on top of the foundation that the Early Access development has provided. During Early Access, our key word has been [b]BUILD[/b]. Build features, iterate on them, polish the core game and gameplay. Our new key word after 1.0 is [b]GROW[/b]. New features will be aimed at attracting new players and giving players more reasons to stick around while staying true to our core values.

See you on April 11th ːreboundː 
- The Oddshot Games team

[h1]Rebound v0.75.0 is live![/h1]
Hey Slappers! Here’s an update to prepare the game (and you!) for the next one that will launch in two weeks and mark the end of the first pre-season of Slapshot Rebound.

[h2]Pre-season 1 is ending![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37173422/38e0542e46b2f40747967006adb75f13b01e8237.png[/img]
We entered Pre-season 1 with the release of ranked, which will be ending on December 19th, marking the beginning of Pre-season 2. This will be the last season before the full launch of the game next year!

Of course a season ending comes with rewards! All slappers who have reached a rank at least once will receive the exclusive Pre-season 1 stick. You will also receive all the sticks for each rank below the one you have achieved. I’m sure you have some questions, so here’s some answers:

[b]How many matches do I need to have played at a rank to get the rewards?[/b]
None. Reaching it once will have qualified you for the rewards of that rank.

[b]Will my rank reset at the end of the season?[/b]
Ranks will be soft reset, meaning you’ll need to do placement matches again but it’ll still take into account the rating you achieved last season for matchmaking during those placement matches.

[b]When do I get the rewards?[/b]
They’ll be distributed around the start of the new season.

[b]How do I know which rewards I qualify for now?[/b]
We don’t have a way to show this right now, but will add something during the next season. Your best bet is to just get the highest rank you can in the next two weeks :-) 

[b]What’s changing next season?[/b]
We’re always changing how ratings and matchmaking work throughout the seasons. This gives us a chance to let those changes shine better with a clean slate. Expect more improvements throughout pre-season 2 as well.

[h2]Rebound birthday![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37173422/9af02af7617e0e185f3c495f9dfc8a7c8a70142c.png[/img]

[h3]Reworked tutorial[/h3]

The tutorial has been changed to accommodate for a true first time player experience, giving a better insight into how input works in Slapshot and making sure every step is easier to understand than before so new players are better equipped before they get on the ice!

[h3]Winter is coming[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37173422/f61114500bcb3a42a15b40331a47861c9a0dd551.jpg[/img]
We’re moving on from the autumn locker room to a cozy winter cabin! Let’s decorate it soon :-)

[h1]Rebound v0.73.0 is now live! ːreboundː[/h1]
Most of our time was spent working on performance and other less flashy but very important things.
There's still a bunch of things related to that that aren't ready yet so stay tuned for more boring but essential things!

[h2]New gamemode: Freezetag![/h2]
Freezetag lets you choose between being a tagger and a runner. This works with a 'best of' round system.
The round ends when the time rune out (runners win) or all runners are frozen (taggers win).
- As a tagger, hit the runners to freeze them. 
- As a runner, get away and tag frozen teammates to unfreeze them!

This mode has no pucks, it's all about movement. 
Freezetag is available in custom games. Let us know what you think of it!

[h2]Performance fixes and improvements[/h2]
Significantly improved CPU usage of the game as well as memory allocation (less/no more stutters!)
Nerd stuff ahead: The reduced memalloc produces 82% less garbage each frame, putting less strain on the GC which avoids stutters.

[h2]Quality of Life[/h2]
- Completely remade our Steam integration. Should not make a difference right now but will help us integrate with Steam more in the future (Rich presence, Steam sockets & relay for player hosted servers)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37173422/440fe8afe0dbc3d1a919e1c21406aec8ba1c5fbc.png[/img]

[h1]Rebound v0.70.1 is now live[/h1]

Small patch, big impact.

[h2]Gameplay - Removed the catch-up mechanic[/h2]
After weeks of testing with various levels of players, we've decided to remove this mechanic to better reward more skilled and coordinated gameplay. This mechanic used to let you go over the max speed if you have been skating in a straight line. This was originally intended to give defenders a chance to catch up again if they had been outplayed, but as the game and meta evolved, it was no longer beneficial and hindered good gameplay. The change will allow people that have outplayed an opponent more room to make a pass or shot. It will encourage better team positioning both for offense and defence.

[h2]Matchmaking - Special case for parties[/h2]
We have optimized the in-match balancing for games where 1 party of two players is present. Before, it would put the party on a team and then alternate adding players to a team sorted by their skill rating as normal. This broke in this scenario and caused many suboptimal matches. This case is now handled separately and will go through every possible team option and pick the one with the lowest difference in rating between the teams.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37173422/2239a9caae678fa259e178832284eb9cb39d7cfc.png[/img]

Update v0.68.0 is now live! 🏒 

[h1]Highlights[/h1]
[h2]- Ranks have been rebalanced[/h2]
[h2]- Share camera settings[/h2]
[h2]- Better dodgepuck bots[/h2]
[h2]- Premium: Customize quick chat[/h2]
[h2]- Premium: Camera presets[/h2]
[h2]- Premium: Extra 12500 Pux[/h2]

[h1]Full patch notes[/h1]
- Ranks have been rebalanced to follow a proper gaussian curve. They'll be more consistent and better reflect how you compare to others.
-- Most people will have a lower rank than before. This doesn't change how your skill is relative to other people, just makes it easier to compare.
- Camera settings and chat settings have been moved to their own settings tabs (camera and social).
- Premium users can now completely customize their quick chat messages
-- This is moderated the same way as normal chat. Toxic behavior will result in loss of chatting privileges. 
- Added camera presets for premium users. You can make new presets, rename them and remove them.
-- Two new keybinds have been added to cycle through your presets in an active match. Default is keypad 1 and 2. (Bottom of controls settings)
- Premium users will now get $5 of pux (12500) for being a premium user. This applies to all people that were premium already and future premium players.
- Birthday event: Log in between December 7 and 14 to receive something to celebrate 2 years of Slapshot: Rebound!
- Added a really cool neon stick. Keep an eye on the shop 👀 
- Added gloves: Frostbite, Deathgrip, Claws. These will be feature in the Patreon vote (one of them will become exclusive to Patreon).
- Improved performance related to puck positions and lifting
- Fixed a bug where the tilt animation for the stick lift would be incorrect sometimes.
- Fixed a bug that would rarely crash the entire Slapshot Services server caused by a third party library
- Fixed a bug where the face-off puck drop would be inconsistent. Now a puck drop always happens except for in Dodgepuck.

[h1]Why the rank rebalance?[/h1]
The ranks were drifting because the ratings were settling over time after implementing ranked. This caused the distribution to have unwanted local maxima and minima. The "curve" looked like this:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37173422/ecfa54d93e6927233401add08a9c252db9cc40b6.png[/img]

Because we now have better insight into how the ratings have been settling, we were able to adjust the system to form a more proper gaussian curve. Coincidentally this also makes the rating differences per rank more uniform - meaning the gaps between ranks in similar scenarios are way closer than before, making climbing the ranks a lot more satisfying and make more sense.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37173422/dd182943d8645639844a55138bd7d69716eda968.png[/img]

The stats above are made based on active players that have completed their placement matches.

You may ask: Why is Legend 1%? We opted to make the Legend rank unique in a way where if you come across a Legend player - you know they're the top 1% of the game. We weren't sure if we'd keep it this way with the rebalance so we polled the community and you all voted to keep it at 1%. If you want to participate in votes that have an impact on the game, feel free to join our [url=https://discord.slapshot.gg]Discord[/url] and click the bell in #get-roles to be notified of future polls.

GLHF

notes.title: Introducing Dodgepuck!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37173422/42d0d5d09a85914d26dfbd71f6ca333424c86da9.png[/img]

Hi Slappers!

We're happy to introduce a new game mode to Slapshot called Dodgepuck!
Dodgepuck has no goals but it does have multiple pucks. It's a team-based game mode where your goal is to hit the opposing team in the head with a puck. It's not easy, trust me.

To spice things up we've made a custom dodgepuck arena that features a few obstacles including tires that have significant bounciness to them so you can make some insane plays for your montages. There is only the initial faceoff (and potential overtime faceoff). Scoring does not interrupt play.

Our objective for this patch was stability improvements and refactoring of a bunch of old code. The most fun way to do this is to make support for more game modes in the process thus dodgepuck was born.

[h1]Changes[/h1]
- Added a new game mode: Dodgepuck. Available in custom games.
- Added a new arena: Dodgepuck (creative, I know) with obstacles and zero goals.
- Taught bots how to play dodgepuck (they'll get better at it soon)
- Matchmaking: Changed the way parties are weighed in matchmaking to make for more fair games. You'll be way less likely to queue into a party with anyone in it much above your own rating.
- Added a game mode and arena selector to the Bot Match practice mode
-- Note: When playing dodgepuck with bots, make sure to select hard or they'll hardly score
- Improved the performance of various game elements
- Took Outdoor and Outdoor Night out of the map rotation and selection for investigation related to a C++ run-time error we've been chasing. (Let us know if you still encounter it!)
- Added a consent pop-up for personalized ads (they were not before, and will not be if you decline).
- Added cosmetics Snowman, Frozen and Gingerbread.

Please let us know what you think about dodgepuck. Is it fun? Is it too difficult? We're hoping to feature the game mode in the upcoming Pond (social hub) as the primary game mode to practice and mess around in while you're in a queue (or not).

Keep on slapping,
Oddshot Games

notes.title: Ranked: Preseason 1
notes.content:
Sup Slappers,

I'm happy to introduce ranks to Slapshot: Rebound!
You'll probably have questions, and I have answers - so let's get to it

[h2]What ranks are there?[/h2]

- Bronze I
- Bronze II
- Bronze III
- Silver I
- Silver II
- Silver III
- Gold I
- Gold II
- Gold III
- Platinum I
- Platinum II
- Platinum III
- Legend

[h2]What will the average rank be?[/h2]
Low to mid gold.

[h2]How many people will be Legend?[/h2]
Less than 1% of the playerbase.

[h2]Is there a separate playlist?[/h2]
No. We opted to have the public playlist be entirely ranked to not split the playerbase. Over the last few months, updates have been rolled out to slowly transform it into ranked.

More casual players, don't fret - this is supposed to be a balanced gamemode. The purpose of the ranks is to see how you measure up to others and to track your own progress.

[h2]When do I get a rank?[/h2]
It requires 10 placement matches before you get assigned a rank.

[h2]Did my rating reset?[/h2]
No, ratings were not reset. You'll still need the placement matches though!

[h2]Rewards?[/h2]
More info about rewards will be released later.

[h2]Rewards?[/h2]
More info about rewards will be released later.

[h2]My rank is fluctuating a lot[/h2]
Yep, we have not added any protections against this because we want your rank to reflect your current rating as accurately as possible. In some ranks, most notable around Gold, your rank might go up/down a lot in a few matches because a lot of people are banded around that rating.

While ranked is released, it does not mean our work on matchmaking and rating calculations is finished. Our aim is still to create a good distribution that will ultimately cause less fluctuations.

[h2]What does preseason mean?[/h2]
It's so when people say they want more/different features in it, we can say "hey, it's a preseason!".

Seriously though, just like we're using Early Access so the game's direction can be determined with the community, the same is true for ranked. We didn't want to add any bloat features or things people don't really want - so it will be a living feature just like the rest of the game. Got feedback for us? Please post it in our [url=discord.slapshot.gg]Discord[/url]. We'd love to hear it.

[h2]I'm playing against ranks that are quite different from mine[/h2]
Yea, that can happen when there's not a lot of people online. Our system is made to prefer giving you any match over none at all. We're working towards some marketing pushes that'll help introduce more players to Slapshot and thus improve the matchmaking experience!

[h2]Is ranked finished?[/h2]
Nope. We'll keep working on it. Tell us what changes or extra features you want to see!

[h2]I have another question[/h2]
Ask us! We're always around on our [url=discord.slapshot.gg]Discord[/url].

GLHF
The Slapshot team

notes.title: New body/puck physics, rating calculations, jumbo arena,..
notes.content:
[h1]Rebound v0.63.0 is live[/h1]

This update took a bit longer than expected because a bunch of things that don't directly impact the features have been refactored to make it easier for us to build and change features in the future. Not the most fun but essential for long running big projects!

[h2]Overhaul to puck interaction with the player body[/h2]
After a ton of testing and experimenting we've found a good state for the player body and puck interactions. It will make the puck hitting you more predictable. Its purpose is, for example, if you catch the puck with your body it's less likely to go into the net if you're in front of it. This is a buff to defensive play and passing plays. Thank you to everyone that helped us make progress and test this for months.

[h2]Re-added backfill[/h2]
By popular request, we have re-added the backfill feature. It was removed to prepare for ranked but the community was clear in what it wants most of all: A good matchmaking and match experience. Backfill helps keep matches going when someone leaves and doesn't necessarily have to go to a forfeit or mercy. People getting backfilled will not receive any loss penalties if they lose, but will reap the rewards if they help the team win! Leaving a match you were backfilled into will still give you a penalty though. We'll be adding a toggle for whether you want to be backfilled at all in a later update.

[h2]Rating calculation tweaks[/h2]
We've made some adjustments to how ratings are calculated, it should help fix the downwards trend in ratings and stabilise average skill levels towards the starting ratings. Of course we'll keep monitoring and tweaking this as we go.

[h2]Added a jumbo arena[/h2]
Slapville has gotten a big brother. Slapville jumbo is 5% bigger in width and length than its normal sized counterpart. Most people probably won't notice the difference very quickly but it does make a big difference for the people that prefer to play the game in a 4v4 format. The size was decided with the European Slapshot League. We may adjust the specific size in the future after more playtime has been clocked into the new rink. You can select the arena in custom games and in practice mode with the arena command in the developer console (check keybinds). [u]The jumbo arena will not appear in public matchmaking.[/u]

[h2]Added a difficulty dropdown to bot matches[/h2]
Previously, you could only play against the hard setting of the bots, now you can select easy mode.

[h2]This update's cosmetics[/h2]
Added tank top, dollar bill mouth item, catphones, basketball head, sunflower hat.

[h2]Better start-up error handling[/h2]
If your Steam authentication has expired and you require a Steam restart, it'll now tell you so instead of just saying it can't connect to the Slapshot services.

[h2]Improved leave penalty[/h2]
The leave penalty should have a lot less false positives when leaving a match that is in theory finished.

[h2]Fixed preset changes in parties[/h2]
Before, when you changed your preset your party members wouldn't see the change until you changed another cosmetic. This is now fixed.

Thank you for your patience. A bunch of these changes were picked from the [url=https://discord.gg/d6hMVY8s2G]feedback channel in Discord[/url] so please don't hesitate to post there if you have any ideas for things you'd like to see in Slapshot: Rebound.

With the removal of backfill, we no longer need to get AFK people out of the match ASAP.
This leaves a bigger grace period for those that didn't realise the queue popped, for example.

notes.content:
[h1]Rebound v0.59.0 is live![/h1]

This is a big one that adds a lot of much needed things and puts down the groundworks for some more awesome things that are to come!

[h2]NEW[/h2]
- Added bots
-- You can now find two new practice modes, one with a goalie bot and a full bot match where you decide the team sizes
-- In the future, you will be able to add bots to your custom matches online too
- Added an animation to the scorebug when a team scores
- Added several extra crowd sounds to improve the ambience relative to the map (you can turn it down in Audio -> Ambience)
-- More crowd cheers during the match
-- Crowd anticipates the end of the match, cheering the players on as the clock ticks down
-- Crowd cheers for goals and the end of the match
-- Added a slight delay to the goal horn to improve realism
- Added an experience tracker at the end of a public match
- Overhauled the game info widget (in queue and in lobby), also made them accessible to controller
- Added a leave penalty of 5 minutes for leaving a public match
-- Some of the matchmaking issues were people's ratings being completely wrong because they left so many matches. 
-- Now, it's faster to finish your match rather than to leave. Make the best of it! I've seen some crazy comebacks.
- Added a sound for time warnings
- Added an icon of the item's type to the store items
- Added controller support for the region selector

[h2]Matchmaking[/h2]
Matchmaking has had a bunch of changes between the last update and now. Thank you to everyone that helped us finetune it so far.
There's still a lot of improvements coming to it, we're monitoring and balancing queue times, match quality and other factors.
- Capped the rating for the matchmaker, improving queue times for people on the extreme ends of the ratings without a large match quality penalty
- Made matchmaking in your own skill range faster by setting a default start offset for the rating range search
- Increased the soft cap of the rating search range to compensate for the wider range of ratings in the new system
- Sped up the search for the matchmaking range between your rating and the soft cap
- Slowed down the search for matchmaking range past the soft cap, increasing match quality
- Backfill is now entered into the matchmaker as its own entity, meaning it'll do a search just like players instead of taking anyone in range
-- This means that players that have been in queue for a hot second won't have a disproportionate amount of backfills
- Fixed an issue where backfills would cause everyone's new calculated ratings to be way too high or low

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
- Fixed occasional incorrect container panel rendering of dynamic lists in UI
- Periods toggle and match length options are now greyed out for non-owners of the lobby
- Fixed and improved the net physics interactions and added support for multiple pucks
- Fixed the call puck feature making the puck go to bots
- Fixed FPS cap not applying to main menu

[h2]Cosmetics[/h2]
- Added hat trick and axe hats from the original Slapshot
- Added shark back item

[h2]Other[/h2]
- Updated our Unity LTS version which may provide some performance enhancements (or break everything, who knows!)
- Updated the graphics texture of the goal nettings to make it look a bit more realistic
- Updated the ice scratches texture that fades in over time while you're on the ice to be more visible

[h1]WHAT'S NEXT?[/h1]
As we're finalising the finetuning of the new matchmaking algorithm, we have determined which ratings will get which ranks for ranked which is now closer than ever. We'll continue improving the bot intelligence, add difficulty settings, continue our work on the ambience of the game and provide more custom lobby options.

GLHF
Oddshot Games

notes.title: Rebound v0.56.0
notes.content:
[h1]Rebound v0.56.0 is live![/h1]

In this patch, we addressed some much needed changes to gameplay and fixed some long standing bugs.

[h2]Gameplay changes[/h2]
- Controller nerf: Brought stick rotation speed to be the same as mouse input
-- This makes bumping and shot speeds equal for all input types, as well as making stick rotation on controller more consistent
- Buffed controller dizziness to compensate for the change above; also brought on par with mouse input
- Balanced the catch-up speedup mechanic where preserving momentum allows you to go over max speed; this now enters a 1 second cooldown when dashing in a different direction
-- You preserve your current momentum even over max speed when dashing, it only prevents further speedup for the cooldown time.
- Nerfed the catch-up mechanic by 40% to encourage better positioning and discourage dumping
- Fixed an issue with max speed consistency when slowing down
- Fixed an issue where holding the dash button after the dash has concluded allowed you to still dash chip the puck, now only triggers when the dash is in progress
-- There is a 1 second margin after the dash completes to perform your chip shot to allow for multiple playstyles (carrying or boosting into the puck or dekeing right before)

[h2]New promo / code redeem feature[/h2]
- The shop page now has a 'redeem code' button
-- We'll be running promotions giving away free stuff through this feature
-- Want to test it out? Use the code FIRST to get 1000 pux. The first 500 people to use it get it!

[h2]Cosmetics[/h2]
- Fixed cat ears topology causing weird shadows on it
- Added the OG hockey mask, grim reaper hoodie, cucumber, lime, orange, grapefruit and lemon puck, mono-eyes and tri-eyes, dog ears, baby hair

[h2]Other[/h2]
- Added a popup for pux earned (promo, level up, manual by devs,..) for when you're online
- Added a popup for cosmetic unlock including when you make a shop purchase
- Spectator camera now defaults to the caster cam
- Added a new console command spectate that you can use in practice mode to go into freecam for content creators
- Added a setting in custom game lobbies to change the current active period when periods are enabled 

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
- Fixed pressing the reset button online causing a desync (for real this time)
- Fixed the hide spectator camera buttons setting
- Fixed an issue where people that left before the end game screen would show just 'username' on the scoreboard
- Fixed an issue where pop-ups mid-game would cause the game to unfocus completely and require opening the menu
- Fixed a memory leak that would cause crashes for some players
- Fixed an issue where some popups would display under other UI
- Fixed custom lobby period setting not toggling correctly the first time you load the UI in your session
- Fixed an issue with arena selection in custom lobbies glitching / resetting

[h1]What's next?[/h1]
- We're making really promising progress on bots!
- The gameplay changes made this patch will be monitored and tweaked if necessary
- I'll be working on a 'recommended' regions selection that's used by default to avoid people queueing into a really high ping region by just selecting all regions.
- Another feature I've wanted to implement for a long time is the option to simulate network latency in practice mode for muscle memory, I'll be starting this too
- We are investigating a way for you to add people as friends in-game so you don't need to have them added on your current platform and allow cross-platform parties
- A rework for matchmaking ratings is in the works for ranked

GLHF

notes.title: Rebound v0.54.0 - Gameplay, mini rink, one-timer practice + more
notes.content:
[h1]Rebound v0.54.0[/h1]

[i][b]Dev note: [/b]We're really excited about this patch and the features it brings to the game.  Many requested gameplay tweaks, a new arena type, new tools for practice, and so much more. We know it's been a little bit since we put out an update so thank you all for your patience and we hope you all think the wait was worth it.  Special thanks to everyone who helped us decide on the gameplay changes and find bugs before the launch.

This update provides us with the foundation we needed to bring our focus to ranked[/i]

[h2]Gameplay[/h2]
[b]Reduced dash strength[/b].  This change makes controlling the puck during dashes easier.  This change also makes quick side-to-side dashes require the use of the stop mechanic which raises the skill ceiling.

[b]Increased stick mass[/b].  This makes touches with the puck more consistent.

[b]Puck speed rework. [/b]We've reworked how we handle max puck velocity and can now separately control max puck speed in the air, on the ice from non dash-shots, and on the ice from dash-shots.  With the stick mass change above we had to rebalance everything in this regard.  It should be generally close to what was in the previous patch.  We did slow down lifted shots a bit and speed up on-ice dash-shots to give players more incentive to use them.

[b]Keyboard & Mouse / Controller rebalance[/b].  In conjunction with the above changes, we've been focused on rebalancing 

[b]Chip puck mechanic. [/b] The mechanic results in a lifted puck that doesn't have a lot of speed  It's a great option as a change-up shot or a short pass over a defender's stick. The mechanic can be performed with a dash + lift and a very slight rotation of the stick.  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37173422/9ce42fe97201113c1e4840537fedbf64f317b9d2.gif[/img]

[b]Updated head hitbox [/b]. We noticed some goals were being scored where a player was generally positioned in a good spot.  This new head shape should be more forgiving in those cases.  You should also now notice that the puck deflecting off of the head has more predictable results than before.  Additionally, pucks that hit the top part of the player head are less likely to deflect up and over a player.

[h2]General[/h2]
[b]One-timer practice mode[/b].
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37173422/3e178243015bdc37705b59c4b005df800b6d3a26.gif[/img]

[b]Mini Slapstadium Arena[/b]. The new arena is available for custom games. It features a smaller rink where the area behind the net was removed. We think this should make 1v1s and 2v2s more viable and fun in custom games.

[b]Hat trick effect[/b]. Spectators now throw hats on the ice when a hat trick is scored
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37173422/c612f005dcbe3bd296f2aa9c1492d7da8b8a73af.gif[/img]

[b]Call puck[/b].  Players can call the puck to the forehand of their stick in the free and obstacle practices by pressing a single button [default Q on KBM, D-pad Up on Controller].  In practices where this is enabled players can also set a custom spawn location (and rotation) [default C on KBM, D-pad Down on Controller], set a puck spawn location [default F on KBM, D-pad Left on Controller], and set a puck target location [default G on KBM, D-pad Right on Controller].  Holding the puck spawn location or puck target location buttons will raise the height of them.  Pressing the reset button [default R on KBM, Select on Controller] when a puck target is set will instantly move the puck from its spawn location to the start.   Holding the reset button will reset everything back to default. To accompany this there are also new dev console commands 'callpuckspeed' & 'callpuckrandom' (with inputs speed & pos ([for position])
[code]Examples:

callpuckspeed 2 //callpuckspeed is the default speed
callpuckrandom speed 1.2 //callpuckrandom speed isa multiplier applied to the upper limit of callpuckspeed
callpuckrandom pos 5 //callpuckrandom position varies the horizontal location of the puck target
[/code][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37173422/0e3e5ff41a9fa4e987748925ba035d1b1ad678e5.gif[/img]

[b]Shot speed on goals[/b]. Goals will now display the speed on the puck (note this is in mph for US and UK and kph elsewhere)

[b]Speedometer[/b].  A shot speedometer has been added to the top of the net in the obstacle practice
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37173422/13de115590b1e883a659c7f08371c7785cd9d4e2.jpg[/img]

[b]More fireworks[/b]. When players achieve a new Personal Record in any of the practice modes, fireworks will now display for a short period of time

[b]Team Locker room helmet colors[/b]. Helmets on the shelves in the locker room now display with the current team color.

[b]New ads.[/b]. To help support the development of the game we've implemented some new ad locations and made some adjustments to all of the arenas and rinks to accommodate them.  We'll be doing some additional updates to make them fit in even better soon.

[h2]Cosmetics[/h2]

[b]Additional Premium perk.[/b] Slappers with premium now receive edge LED glasses

[b]Head cosmetics[/b]. Knight helmet, miniature hat, wizard hat, astronaut helmet, Thief
[b]Eyewear cosmetics[/b]. Ski goggles, Bandit
[b]Stick cosmetics[/b]. LED, Sword, Butcher
[b]Jersey cosmetic[/b]. Boom
[b]Back cosmetics[/b]. Knight shield, Satchel, Salty
[b]Glove cosmetics[/b]. LED, Thief

[b]New variants.[/b] Watermelon, executioner, shutter glasses, gauntlet, cubana

[h2]Quality of life[/h2]
[b]Auto reset zoom[/b].  Changing camera settings where zoom is calculated will now automatically reset zoom

[b]God mode[/b]. As an ode to some of our favorite childhood games we've added a 'god' dev console command for infinite stamina and dizziness in practice, this will save across sessions.

[b]Custom high latency indicator threshold[/b].  Added a new 'sethighlatencyindicator' dev console command for players to set the ping at which the high latency indicator displays
[code]Example:
sethighlatencyindicator 70 //will show the high latency indicator only when your ping at or above 70[/code]
[b]Optimized target shatter[/b].  The target shatter effect in some practice modes has been optimized and is now linked to the particle effects setting so it can be disabled.

[b]Reduced winning team nametag size[/b]. The size of names for the winning team on the end-screen podium has been reduced

[b]Optimized goalie practice[/b].  The huge FPS drop that arose when players got into the thousands of saves should now be resolved

[b]More legible 'Reset' text[/b].  There is now an outline around the "Reset" text in some practice modes to make it more legible

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
-Server and client performance optimizations, reducing the amount of bandwidth used resulting in more stable latency and a smoother experience online
-Fixed an issue where matches could be ended as players connected
-Changed the way zoom settings save when leaving, this should result in fewer issues where zoom is set incorrectly when returning to a game
-Returning to the main menu from the identity menu will now properly reset the player's rotation
-Fixed a bug where spectators weren't unloaded after using the arena dev console command
-Fixed own team indicators not setting correctly when changed mid-game/practice
-Fixed an issue where if a player's zoom button was tied to their skip replay button, it would change their zoom
-Fixed a bug with the arena dev console command
-Popped water bottles will now replay on replays
-Disabled quick chat in practice
-Fixed an issue where the bone stick clipped through the front of gloves
-Fixed some issues with the ice material on cosmetics
-Changed the shape of the Cubana hat
-The position and rotation of some gloves have been made consistent


Good luck, have fun
AIA & team

notes.content:
[h1]Rebound v0.53.1[/h1]

[h2]Taking a stance on toxicity.[/h2]
We've taken note of people's experiences and there are still far too many instances of people behaving in unacceptable ways.
This update helps address some of these issues further, and while it will not solve everything, it is a step in the right direction.
Over the coming updates we will be adding more of these features as deemed necessary to help form a welcoming community.

[h2]General[/h2]
- From now on, when a person gets muted / banned with help from your reports, you will be notified of it
- Improved hate speech detection to take into account some creative ways to be an asshole
- Increased automatic chat bans from 3 days to 1 month when detecting hate speech; 
-- We were afraid of false positives when we first launched automatic mutes but have seen a 95%+ effective rate
-- If the system mutes you and you believe it was a false positive, please submit a ticket using #help in Discord. 
- If someone is caught by our automated system, their chat ban will be announced to other players in the same match
- Upgraded Unity engine to LTS 2020.3.9

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
- Fixed collision detection between the net and cones in practice mode
- Improved stats UI to allow for bigger numbers (thank you Valo for reporting this)
- The match sharing website now correctly shows arena, periods and which period (for matches played after the update)
- Hair colors will now level up correctly

GLHF

[h1]Rebound v0.53.0[/h1]

[h2]General[/h2]
- Added a website to share your recent matches with in-depth stats (button in player -> stats -> recent matches)
- Reporting a server will now attempt to generate a report for us when you have it enabled, helping us fix more server related issues
- Added a (free) white puck as a variant of the normal puck to use on dark ice

[h2]Cosmetics[/h2]
- Added hair color, facial hair color, stick cosmetics, stick tape color, stick base color; these will show as 'none selected' for existing accounts
-- Added 6 natural hair colors, these are free  for everyone
-- When getting different hair colors, it unlocks for both hairstyle and facial hair
-- When getting different stick base or tape colors, these can be applied to every stick you have that support it
- Reworked the default look of gloves to not intersect with the player and be higher fidelity
- Added a new variant for the premium jersey
- Added 15+ new cosmetics
- Gave 70+ existing cosmetics new variants

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
- Fixed a bug where you would be put in spectator mode the entire match sometimes
- Fixed an occasional leaderboards updating issue (didn't properly clear a cache, causing memory overflows in Redis)
- Fixed an internal issue for handling reports, let's get some more toxic people out of the game

[h2]Shop[/h2]
- The next featured / daily shop (hitting a few hours from this post) will be 100% never seen before items, including sticks!

[h1]WHAT'S NEXT?[/h1]
Our focus now will be on gameplay balancing, competitive and ranked. 

[h2]- Gameplay balancing[/h2]
Most notably, there's been a bigger discrepancy in the skill level of controller and keyboard & mouse players now that people are reaching higher skill levels. There are several areas with dash, hitting and bounciness that we are investigating to balance better to create more fun gameplay. We'll be rolling out a new process to apply to help with feedback on this soon. 

[h2]- Competitive[/h2]
Leagues, tournaments and other events focused on taking Slapshot to the next level deserve to be in the spotlight. One of our initiatives to fuel this is to make a better system to provide in-game awareness and several other tools to help people run these events. This patch introduces the match sharing website, which kicks off these line-up of improvements for the competitive scene.

[h2]- Ranked[/h2]
We're getting rid of our current MMR system (elo) in favor for something custom built (inspired by TrueSkill) that will make it easier for the system to place you in an appropriate skill level faster and provide more fair matches to truly measure your skill at the game. Ranks and other supporting elements will be introduced with a ranked playlist. 

We may choose to roll these updates out over multiple patches.

Good luck, have fun
Erveon & team
